claim: Hourly RSI/VWAP dip-buying on TQQQ over the full regular session (engine v2) earns a positive risk-adjusted return after instrument costs, beyond what the family's search would produce by chance, and keeps doing so on bars that did not exist when this was frozen.
notes: Candidate = the engine-v2 TQQQ sweep's best_overall (sweep selected with holdout help, F2; the gate deflates against all 362 family trials). Development window starts 2025-06 so yfinance's ~729-day hourly retention still serves it when the forward window matures.
